behaviors.execution_owner: EPaxos run goroutine, instance coordinator and recipient replicas
behaviors.protocol_context: Replica/Instance row identity, initial ballot equals row owner
implementation_guards: PreAccept rejects ballot below inst.bal; ACCEPTED or later preserves attributes and only tries filling missing commands.

Reply handlers compare lastTriedBallot and phase. Fast commit requires FastQuorumSize()-1 replies plus initial ballot, equality and committed-dependency conditions; N<=3/thrifty skips equality, N>7 checks committed dependencies.
Slow commit counts acceptOKs+1>N/2. handleAccept rejects smaller ballots and avoids altering committed instances.
writes: Local proposal allocates crtInstance[Id], initializes PREACCEPTED commands/seq/deps and leader bookkeeping.
PreAccept recipient establishes PREACCEPTED or PREACCEPTED_EQ, bal/vbal and conflict indexes.
Accept recipient updates seq/deps/bal/vbal without assigning ACCEPTED; successful processing still replies with inst.bal.
Coordinator changes bookkeeping and local status to ACCEPTED or COMMITTED; commit calls updateCommitted.
external_effects: Thrifty broadcasts send PreAccept to FastQuorumSize()-1 live preferred peers and Accept to N/2. Commit goes to all live preferred peers.
When Dreply is false, coordinator replies on commit; default Dreply is true.
async_boundaries: Peer codec, per-type queue and select dispatch separate request/reply phases.
unknowns: Does missing ACCEPTED assignment permit later preaccept/recovery to reinterpret support already acknowledged?
Quorum formulas and peer accounting require a separate responsibility check, especially configuration size boundaries.

behaviors.execution_owner: EPaxos per-instance recovery coordinator and prepare recipients
behaviors.protocol_context: bal is joined ballot; vbal is stored value ballot; lb.lastTriedBallot is coordinator attempt
implementation_guards: Recovery returns for committed instances with commands.
Prepare raises bal for a larger request; returns current bal for lower requests.
Prepare reply requires preparing bookkeeping and exact lastTriedBallot. Quorum collection stops at SlowQuorumSize.
writes: Recovery replaces leader bookkeeping while preserving clientProposals, copies prior state then sets bal and vbal to attempted ballot before adding a self reply.
makeBallot uses local ID, adds N when recovering another row, and when IsLeader increments while below maxRecvBallot.
Recovery chooses fields from replies whose VBallot >= selected ballot; equal values use later iteration entries.
Committed selection installs state without broadcast; accepted or qualifying equal preaccept selection broadcasts Accept; other selection restarts phase one with recovered commands or NOOP.
external_effects: Prepare to live peers; handlePrepare sends prior value ballot/status/commands/attributes.
BeTheLeader only sets IsLeader true; it is not global exclusion of proposal owners.

formation.explanation: Client admission allocates an owner-row instance, computes dependencies and sequence from conflicts and preaccepts. Live preferred peers establish or retain local state and reply. Coordinator filters reply ballot/phase, merges attributes, and commits on fast-path predicates or sends Accept. Matching Accept replies plus self support can commit. Commit broadcasts full commands/attributes; receivers reject stale ballots or already-decided state. Execution waits for committed command-bearing dependency graph components before application and default client completion.

context.explanation: Authority is per-instance: original row ballot equals owner ID. Recipients reject below joined bal; Prepare advances bal and reports vbal/history. Incomplete execution prefixes trigger recovery. Recovery replaces bookkeeping, obtains matching-ballot replies, and selects prior state by VBallot before choosing Accept, phase-one restart, or committed installation. A leader flag changes ballot generation but does not remove every replica ability to propose. Old replies are phase/ballot filtered; pending commands can survive via recovered state/clientProposals. Already committed local state resists Accept/Commit replacement.

connection.explanation: Formation creates the stored support later reported by Prepare. Ballot transitions are therefore tied to both current promise and prior value context. Recovery consumer selects by VBallot, while remote serialization omits it and local recovery rewrites it before self-reporting: these are unresolved implementation discrepancies, not a demonstrated legal transfer of prior decisions. The accepted-state assignment gap is independent. Transport queues and recovery timers mean pending old work can overlap transitions; exact handler guards, not global FIFO, determine its effect.
